wiki.title: Theresa Hatathlie
wiki.extract: Theresa Hatathlie is an American Navajo politician who has served as a member of the Arizona Senate from the 6th district since 2023. She was appointed to the District 7 seat in 2022 after incumbent State Senator Jamescita Peshlakai resigned from office. She is a member of the Democratic Party.
